description: This file defines a Java class ServiceLocation within the org.apache.ofbiz.service.config.model package. It models a service location element, capturing its name and location attributes, and includes validation logic in the constructor.

classes.name: ServiceLocation
classes.description: A thread-safe, immutable class that models a <service-location> XML element, encapsulating its name and location attributes with validation.

methods.name: ServiceLocation (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs a ServiceLocation object from an XML Element and a location string. Validates that 'name' and 'location' attributes are not empty; throws ServiceConfigException if invalid.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location string of the service location.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service location.
